chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador began by his Advent
chapter_note: After a brief hagiographic dialogue attribution (¶1), the chapter is an impersonal, enumerated cosmological list of ten effects initiated by the Third Ambassador’s advent. The numbered schematic style and purely cosmic machinery vocabulary indicate an old teaching core preserved with minimal later overlay; lacunae affect items 4–6.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic frame attribution (“Once again the enlightener speaks”) marks the later hagiographic container introducing the list.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.87⟩
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered schematic exposition of cosmic agents/events without citation or institutional material; fits the impersonal teaching register.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
paragraphs.temporal_note: List-structure cosmological mechanics (ships/heights/heavens) in impersonal voice suggests pre-compilation teaching item.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System description (“wheels…send the life…”) is process-oriented cosmology characteristic of the oldest layer.
Although lacunose, it continues the numbered cosmological sequence with no signs of later frame/overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [ ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mechanical/cosmic imagery (“doors of the ships…opened”) in the continuing list form; no institutional or citation markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the doors too [ ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the same schematic mechanism (cosmic ‘doors’ handling ‘waste’ as part of purification machine) indicates core teaching despite lacunae.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic process account involving the Third Ambassador and the rulers; [the sin] functions as a personified cosmic agent/event within purification mechanics, not moral exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: Night and day were separated [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmogonic differentiation (night/day separation) presented as an item in the enumerated scheme; no later overlay markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief but still an impersonal cosmological event within the tenfold list; no frame/pastoral/NT signals.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Concludes the tenfold schematic with technical cosmological/eschatological process language; no citation or institutional extension.
